title: Relay sends from DL560 to native Central sessions still intermittently return 503 'native mailbox relay response unavailable' (recurs after completed w-d3862af346b9)
outcome:
w-d3862af346b9, a 503 on a relay READ of Opus2's mailbox from DL560, is completed. The same 503 class still occurs on relay SENDS from DL560 after Central's restart onto fbc6fd0c.

Occurrence, reported by Engram::Codex-DL560-Cleanup in relay mailbox 02f17444 #7 and recorded on w-d386 as evidence 5512eff6:
- Date: 2026-11-24, just before 08:47:54Z.
- Call: termal_send_to_session to the native Engram::Fable session (Central session-5135), idempotency key dl560-fable313-8f12-f3b26fca-cleanup.
- It took 6.8 s and returned: "TermAl delegation API returned 503 Service Unavailable: native mailbox relay response unavailable; central mailbox outcome may be unknown; retry the original request with the same idempotencyKey".
- An identical retry succeeded as #314 at 08:47:54.491Z (duplicate=false). No loss and no duplicate.

Impact: idempotent retry recovers every case seen so far, so this is cost and noise, not lost mail. Each occurrence still costs the sender a turn and an uncertain-outcome step.

Wanted:
- Establish why the relay response is unavailable while the append succeeds on retry: a timeout on the relay hop, a link renegotiation, or Central's lock hold during the send.
- Fix it, or bound and document it.
Facts only; no cause is asserted here.
acceptance: Relay sends from DL560 to native Central sessions still intermittently return 503 'native mailbox relay response unavailable' (recurs after completed w-d3862af346b9) is done
